context:
Defer the implementation until production cadence is known. The
workflow's draft-only design means stale PRs are visible but
non-blocking; cleanup is a quality-of-life improvement, not a
correctness requirement.
description:
The `sync-results-data-to-published.yml` workflow that landed in W4 of
`published-results-slim-down-and-corpus-mirror` opens a fresh draft PR
named `auto/results-mirror-<develop-SHA8>` for every develop push that
changes corpus paths. Old auto-mirror PRs and branches accumulate over
time — the workflow has no cleanup mechanism today.

Wait for the workflow to run in production for one or two months, then
decide what cleanup looks like based on actual cadence and PR volume.
As of the 2026-05-26 TODO review, live GitHub state showed the first
matching auto-mirror PR was opened on 2026-05-06, so the earliest
one-month review point is 2026-06-06. Keep this TODO Blocked until
that date, then run W0/W1 against current GitHub state before designing
cleanup.

anti_patterns.dont: auto-close auto-mirror PRs that have been opened for less than the configured staleness window
anti_patterns.instead: gate cleanup on age + draft status + presence of a newer mirror PR for the same series.
anti_patterns.why: the maintainer may be in the middle of reviewing

deferrals.reason: Pre-W4 there were no auto-mirror branches to clean up; this TODO scope is bounded to branches the workflow itself creates.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: Reason states scope is explicitly bounded to branches the workflow itself creates; pre-W4 there was nothing of this kind to clean up.
deferrals.summary: Cleanup of pre-W4 manual mirror branches

preserves.behavior: Auto-mirror PRs labelled by a maintainer (e.g. `keep`, `needs-review`) must NOT be auto-closed.
Auto-mirror PRs that a maintainer has flipped from draft to ready-for-review must NOT be auto-closed.

prior_art.concept: .github/workflows/nightly.yml, .github/workflows/release-canary.yml — existing `schedule:`-triggered workflows; REUSE their cron + gh-cli idiom if a sibling cleanup workflow is added instead of extending the W4 workflow
.github/workflows/sync-results-data-to-published.yml — the W4 workflow that opens the auto-mirror draft PRs; EXTEND it with a cleanup step (preferred) rather than introducing a new module

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from datetime import datetime, timezone; raise SystemExit(0 if datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat() >= '2026-06-06' else 1)"
verifications.description: One-month production window has elapsed before cleanup design begins

verifications.command: gh pr list --base published-results --state open --search 'head:auto/results-mirror- draft:true' --json createdAt --jq '[.[] | select((now - (.createdAt|fromdateiso8601)) > 2592000)] | length'
verifications.description: No superseded auto-mirror draft PR older than the 30-day staleness window remains open
verifications.expected: 0 after cleanup runs — older superseded auto-mirror drafts are closed; the newest mirror per series may remain open

verifications.description: Auto-mirror branches on origin do not grow unbounded
verifications.expected: <= the configured retention count chosen in w2 (bounded; not monotonically increasing across runs)

work_units.notes:
Earliest start is 2026-06-06 based on the first observed
auto/results-mirror PR date from the 2026-05-26 TODO review. On or
after that date, re-run the GitHub PR/branch queries and record the
first observed auto-mirror PR date in the PR body. If the first date
has changed, keep at least one full month of production runtime before
proceeding to W1.

Do not start before 2026-06-06 unless the first auto-mirror PR date
is rechecked and proves an earlier full-month window. Run:
`gh pr list --base published-results --state all --search "head:auto/results-mirror-"`
and `gh api repos/joeharris76/BenchBox/git/matching-refs/heads/auto/results-mirror`.
Count PRs by status (open/draft, open ready-for-review, merged,
closed-without-merge) and count matching branches. Decide whether
cleanup is needed based on observed cadence.
work_units.summary: Revalidate the calendar gate and audit auto-mirror PR/branch accumulation

work_units.notes:
If audit surfaces meaningful accumulation, extend the sync workflow
(or add a sibling scheduled workflow) to:
  - Close stale auto-mirror draft PRs older than N days where a newer
    auto-mirror PR exists for the same series.
  - Delete the corresponding auto-named branch.
Skip merged or human-edited (label `needs-review` or non-draft) PRs.
